Food

What the taverna serves

From the photos and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Steaks and lamb from the grill

T-bone, steaks and lamb chops with grilled vegetables. One guest writes that the lamb comes from a neighbouring farm.

Vegetables from the garden

Guests write that the vegetables come from the owner's own garden. One remembers a plate of fresh berries from his farm at the end of dinner.

Meze, tuna and salad

One guest ordered the meze and calls every dish top notch, even the liver. Others mention the tuna and the salad.

From the taverna

Photos from the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

A kind host

3 Google reviews mention the kind staff. One guest calls the owner a sweet man and an excellent cook who cares about his produce.

Generous portions

2 reviews mention the abundant food, 2 the quality. One guest writes that the portions were generous and cooked to perfection.

Local food

2 reviews mention local food, 2 homegrown ingredients. One guest has been coming for more than twenty years.

On Ayiou Georgiou Makri

At Ayiou Georgiou Makri 62 in Larnaca. The Facebook page says the taverna has served quality food and good wine since 1999. Open Monday to Saturday from 18:00 to 22:00, to book a table call 99 454877.

What guests say

Three of 79 Google reviews, 69 of them with five stars.

“Having frequented this small, family-run taverna for more than twenty years, we are happy to report that the qualities that attracted us in the first place, freshness, friendliness and authenticity are exactly the same today.”

Google review
“Ordered the Meze. Each dish that was served was top notch, even the liver! Service was very good and the atmosphere was very good.”
